name: Computer Art Club
source:
A game made by the students of the Computer Art Club using Renpy. In this strange little game you become one a member of the computer art club and learn alongside the other students as a series of bizarre events unfold.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=computerart.club.renpy.one]Google Store[/url]]
